subject.title: Skill and Read tools truncating output at ~600-700 chars in 2026.6.11

question: Should maintainers require live packaged v2026.6.11 reproduction before changing cap policy or Skill Workshop proposal lookup/persistence behavior for this issue?
rationale: Current source and release-tag inspection contradict the claimed 600-700 core caps, while changing cap or workshop matching behavior without the exact failing surface could regress valid bounding and workspace scoping.

options.title: Require live reproduction first
options.body: Keep this issue open with manual review until a Linux gateway run captures raw transcript/config/proposal evidence for the exact failing paths.

options.title: Split by known overlapping tracks
options.body: Route read-only evidence to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/84659, async exec approval evidence to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/41152, and cap configurability to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/82246 while preserving this issue for the broader 2026.6.11/Skill Workshop report.

options.title: Sponsor cap-policy work now
options.body: A maintainer can choose to align display/progress caps with model-visible tool-result settings before full reproduction, accepting compatibility risk around larger tool output.

recommendation.title: Require live reproduction first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open with manual review until a Linux gateway run captures raw transcript/config/proposal evidence for the exact failing paths.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current-main routing candidate across the inspected cap, tool-result, read, exec, web_fetch, and Skill Workshop files.
